verdict.rationale: Supabase lets developers choose project region at creation (data residency/region selection) and offers Read Replicas explicitly for improving latency and load balancing across regions, plus Edge Functions distributed globally close to users. This directly supports placing data/replicas near users for low read latency worldwide. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of actual multi-region replica latency performance, and no detail on write-latency tradeoffs or replica region selection UI.
